data_description.address: The 6 character hexadecimal address of the device.
data_description.inverted: This integration follows the Cover Entity, where open means the screen is retracted and closed the screen is extracted, the same way curtains and garage doors work. For a projection screen this is counterintuitive. You can reverse the behavior.
data_description.serial_port: The serial port your device is connected to.
data_description.time_close: Time needed to close the projector screen.
data_description.time_open: Time needed to open the projector screen.
